content.content: {"result":"{\"answer\":\"Based on my search through the context filesystem, here's what I found about KIP-1274:\\n\\n## Summary\\n\\n**What is KIP-1274?**\\nKIP-1274 is a discussion about deprecating and removing support for the Classic rebalance protocol in KafkaConsumer. The KIP proposes a phased plan to drive a smooth evolution of Java client consumer applications towards the next generation of the rebalance protocol.\\n\\n**Who started it?**\\n**Lianet Magrans** started the discussion thread on **2026-01-22** by posting the initial discussion message to the Apache Kafka development mailing list.\\n\\n**How many distinct people participated by 2026-03-31?**\\n**9 distinct people** participated in the KIP-1274 discussion thread by the cutoff date of 2026-03-31:\\n\\n1. Lianet Magrans (started the discussion)\\n2. Chia-Ping Tsai\\n3. Andrew Schofield\\n4. David Jacot\\n5. Ismael Juma\\n6. Matthias J. Sax\\n7. Ming-Yen Chung\\n8. Kirk True\\n9. Lucas Brutschy\\n\\nThe discussion thread ran from 2026-01-22 through 2026-02-23, when the KIP was voted on and accepted with 4 binding votes (David Jacot, Lucas Brutschy, Andrew Schofield, and Matthias J. ## Summary

**What is KIP-1274?**
KIP-1274 is a discussion about deprecating and removing support for the Classic rebalance protocol in KafkaConsumer. The KIP proposes a phased plan to drive a smooth evolution of Java client consumer applications towards the next generation of the rebalance protocol.

**Who started it?**
**Lianet Magrans** started the discussion thread on **2026-01-22** by posting the initial discussion message to the Apache Kafka development mailing list.

6. Matthias J. Sax
